items.title: Kering H1 2026: 84 net store closures, nearly 40% concentrated in Asian markets
items.summary: The Impression's analysis of Kering's half-year filing notes 84 net store closures completed in H1 2026, on track for the full-year target of about 100, with close to 40% of 2026 closures concentrated in Asian markets. Gucci retail sales decline narrowed to 2% in Q2 versus deeper declines in Q1; jewelry (+18%) and eyewear (+8%) are outpacing Gucci's recovery pace within the group portfolio.

items.title: Gucci Fall/Winter 2026 Primavera preview draws Manila celebrities to Greenbelt 4
items.summary: L'Officiel Philippines covers Gucci's July 31 celebrity-filled preview of the Demna-designed Fall/Winter 2026 Primavera collection at its Greenbelt 4 boutique in Manila. Filipino stars Marian Rivera, Kyle Echarri, Brent Manalo, Kylie Verzosa, Michelle Dee, BJ Pascual and Bella Racelis wore looks featuring the updated Bamboo 1947 bag, Jetset GG Marmont and Horsebit Duomo pieces, part of Gucci's continued high-frequency celebrity activation strategy in the Philippine market.

items.title: Malaysian Threads post questions why Gucci Suria KLCC store closed
items.summary: A Malay-language Threads post asking 'why did Gucci KLCC close' (Kenapa Gucci KLCC tutup) drew notable organic engagement, reflecting public confusion/concern over Gucci's exit from Kuala Lumpur's Suria KLCC mall alongside Dior Men, Bottega Veneta and Berluti, widely attributed locally to elevated rents and KLCC's fading luxury positioning versus rival malls TRX and Pavilion KL. Included despite being outside the ideal freshness window because it is the clearest available SNS-channel signal on this still-unresolved, locally salient story; no more recent public post surfaced in this search.

items.title: Lowyat.NET forum thread: 'Gucci KLCC permanently closed'
items.summary: A thread on Lowyat.NET, Malaysia's largest tech/lifestyle community forum, discusses the permanent closure of the Gucci boutique at Suria KLCC, part of a broader community conversation about luxury retail retrenching from the mall amid high rents and a perceived shift of prestige to TRX and Pavilion KL. Thread content itself could not be fully retrieved (site blocks automated access); included on the strength of corroborating SNS/news coverage of the same closure. Engagement counts unavailable (page inaccessible to the collector).
